notes: Raptor 2 is NOT routed through the Rao table. Published geometry (FAA Analysis Report 2019-001b Table 1): theta_n 32.0 deg, theta_e 6.0 deg, downstream throat arc 0.300 R_t (the Rao/TOP construction's 0.382 R_t does not apply). At eps 34.3 the table matches theta_n at 0.750 (0.00 deg off) but theta_e is 3.64 deg off there, and the percent minimising the WORSE of the two angles (0.821) still misses by 1.85 deg — no bell percent satisfies both, so the table cannot represent this engine. This is a contour-family mismatch, NOT a gamma effect: Rao (1958) states gamma barely moves the contour at fixed length and area ratio, and the sign is inverted (gamma 1.16 vs the chart's ~1.23 makes the exit angle larger, worth under 0.7 deg). The app now takes the two angles directly (ContourKind::DirectBell); 76% remains the LENGTH only.

Adaptive tessellation at 1% of the base cell spacing, 2 deg turn cap, replacing the fixed 256 samples, at each preset's OWN resolution: Merlin 1D 63, F-1 63, Raptor 2 78, AJ10-190 88, RS-25 93, Merlin Vac 100, V-2 (A-4) Model 39 27, Redstone NAA 75-110-A-7 27, Thor LR79-NA-7 (MB-1) 27, Atlas LR89-5 booster 27, Atlas LR105-5 sustainer 27, Titan I LR87-AJ-3 (1 of 2) 27, Titan I LR91-AJ-3 27, WAC Corporal 38ALDW-1500 27. The turn cap sets the count on the throat arcs and the chord tolerance sets it on the Bezier. The comparison against 256 belongs to the default resolutions only: the mesh sets the tolerance, so a user who raises the resolution to the 160 cells/r_t top of the range correctly gets a FINER wall than the old constant (Merlin Vac 268 points, RS-25 215) — that is the adaptive rule working, not a regression.

RS-25 sea level, 15 deg cone (before): over the settled window (steps 6000-12000, nd time 47.14-92.87) mass flow 474.7 kg/s mean (range 267.9-759.8), C_f 1.8094 mean (range 1.6957-1.8897), residual 2.18e-2 at the end, converged false, confidence NotConverged (253 x 415 cells, Compact plume, floors 665). THE WINDOW IS A LIMIT CYCLE, not a steady state — see the rs25-sea-level-unsteady note.

RS-25 sea level, 80% bell (after): over the settled window (steps 6000-12000, nd time 42.70-84.72) mass flow 337.6 kg/s mean (range 35.8-464.2), C_f 1.6243 mean (range 1.4811-1.8451), residual 5.31e-2 at the end, converged false, confidence NotConverged (224 x 415 cells, Compact plume, floors 0). THE WINDOW IS A LIMIT CYCLE, not a steady state — see the rs25-sea-level-unsteady note.

RS-25 at sea level is overexpanded (p_e/p_a ~ 0.21 at the preset's gamma 1.20 — quasi-1D p_e ~ 21.6 kPa against 101.3 kPa ambient, below the 0.40 separation threshold, the SS13 separation-warning regime) and has NO steady state in this inviscid model: a 30k-step probe of both contours shows the shock system breathing in and out of the nozzle, with exit-plane readouts oscillating over mdot 291-738 kg/s (cone) / 48-895 (bell), exit Mach 0.58-2.97 / 0.77-3.59, C_f 1.41-1.86 / 1.43-1.79. The cone-vs-bell C_f comparison is therefore asserted at 20 km (attached flow), not at sea level.

RS-25 at 20 km, 15 deg cone (before): over the settled window (steps 6000-12000, nd time 36.48-70.79) mass flow 489.6 kg/s mean, C_f 1.6667 mean (range 1.6549-1.6780, half-window drift +0.0007), residual 1.14e-2 at the end (11x RESIDUAL_CONVERGED = 1e-3), converged false, confidence NotConverged (253 x 415 cells, Compact plume, floors 1495).

RS-25 at 20 km, 80% bell (after): over the settled window (steps 6000-12000, nd time 34.60-66.62) mass flow 490.7 kg/s mean, C_f 1.6855 mean (range 1.6761-1.6936, half-window drift +0.0009), residual 7.43e-3 at the end (7x RESIDUAL_CONVERGED = 1e-3), converged false, confidence NotConverged (224 x 415 cells, Compact plume, floors 0).

NEITHER 20 km run converges, and nothing here is asserted as if it did: at step 12000 the residual is 1.14e-2 (cone) / 7.43e-3 (bell) against RESIDUAL_CONVERGED = 1e-3 — 11x / 7x above it — StepInfo.converged is false for both and every Report carries Confidence::NotConverged. What IS asserted is the mean over the declared settled window (steps 6000-12000, nd time 36.48-70.79), qualified first by a time-based steadiness check on the same window: C_f half-window drift 0.0007 / 0.0009 (cone/bell) against a cone-to-bell difference of 0.0188, and residual second-half/first-half 0.55 / 0.56. The single-instant version of this assert read +0.0218 at step 5511 and NEGATIVE before step ~2000 — it was a snapshot of a wobble.
